from __future__ import annotations
import asyncpg, pytest
from uuid import uuid4
from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mindmap import workflow_crud, work_items
pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio
\<email>
async def tenant_a(pg_pool):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            return await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO tenants (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id", f"t-{uuid4()}@example.test")
\<email>
async def team_a(pg_pool, tenant_a):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            tid = await conn.fetchval("INSERT INTO teams (name, created_by_tenant_id) VALUES ($1,$2) RETURNING id", f"team-{uuid4().hex[:8]}", tenant_a)
            from mem_mcp.teams.assignments import assign_role
            await assign_role(conn, parent_team_id=tid, member_kind="user", member_id=tenant_a, role_key="owner", assigned_by_user_id=tenant_a)
            return tid

async def test_transitions(pg_pool, tenant_a, team_a):
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tenant_a) as conn:
        lid = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        cnt = await conn.fetchval("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_transitions WHERE workflow_id=$1", lid)
        assert cnt == len(work_items.TRANSITIONS)
        # idempotent
        lid2 = await workflow_crud.materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_a, team_id=team_a)
        assert lid2 == lid
        cnt2 = await conn.fetchval("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_transitions WHERE workflow_id=$1", lid)
        assert cnt2 == len(work_items.TRANSITIONS)
EOF
pytest tests/unit/mindmap/test_tmp_transitions.py -q 2>&1 | tail -20
rm tests/unit/mindmap/test_tmp_transitions.py
